title: Read one Space's provider-free core details with explicit offline truth

requirements.invariant: One query request binds an exact AccountID and stable SpaceID. A found Space binds the same identities and exactly one immutable Project-or-Business-Inventory creation scope; copied names, paths, nullable scope pairs and provider locators cannot define or rebind identity.

Core detail preserves canonical nonblank display name, canonical optional notes, active-or-archived lifecycle, exact UInt64 Space revision and finite createdAt/updatedAt field values. Timestamps are exact record fields only and do not claim server-authored provenance, actor identity, immutability, ordering between the two times or lifecycle-event semantics.

Core detail preserves the complete available ordered checklist hierarchy through stable checklist IDs, normalized nonblank names, explicit checklist order, stable checklist-item IDs unique within each checklist, normalized nonblank item text, explicit item order and checked state. The same item ID in different checklists is valid; duplicate names/text remain valid and no unapproved length cap exists.

Completed and total item counts are derived from checked states for each checklist and the whole Space; caller-authored totals do not exist. Zero checklists and zero-item checklists produce exact 0/0 counts. No percentage is defined, and counts carried by incomplete local evidence remain explicitly non-authoritative.

Cached single-Space data is immediately usable without server acknowledgement while preserving exact local data version, finite as-of time, readiness and completeness evidence. Ready found, ready authoritative absence, incomplete found/empty, partial found/empty and stale found/empty remain distinguishable; incomplete or stale empty evidence never proves absence.

One narrow backend-neutral query port streams updates for the exact request. Waiting, unavailable, retryable and required-update states are explicit; unavailable cannot reveal whether a Space is nonexistent or inaccessible, cached failures cannot rebind the request, upstream failure/cancellation cannot yield a false row or authoritative absence, and local evidence never grants current authorization.

Space is optional organizational placement and independent of Item accounting state. This read contains no Item/assignment, review, media, template, legacy completion, Transaction, Invoice, Purchase, occurrence, budget or accounting evidence and cannot infer any of them from Space scope, lifecycle, checklists or progress.

This Phase 1 read boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free synthetic evidence while the Firebase application remains unchanged. It defines no archive command/effects, persistence, authorization, Postgres schema/handler/grant/RLS, PowerSync Stream, Auth/provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted resource, release or production behavior.

items: SpaceCoreDetailsRequest binds exact AccountID and SpaceID to a deterministic versioned query fingerprint and revalidates that binding after decode.

SpaceCoreDetailsSnapshot reuses verified Space scope/name/notes/checklist/lifecycle/identity primitives and adds exact Space revision plus finite createdAt/updatedAt fields; it canonicalizes hierarchy order through the existing checklist collection and exposes only derived completed/total counts.

SpaceCoreDetailsLocalSnapshot represents at most one exact-request row with exact cardinality/completeness, ListSnapshotQuality, LocalDataVersion and finite as-of evidence. Only a complete ready empty result is authoritative absence; found and absent archived state remain distinct.

SpaceCoreDetailsUpdate and SpaceCoreDetailsFailure expose bounded waiting/snapshot/unavailable/retryable/required-update/refusal semantics without path, query, provider, authorization or existence detail. SpaceCoreDetailsQuerying is the sole narrow port.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: No spaces/checklist table, Account/Project foreign key, lifecycle/revision/timestamp column, constraint, index, view, function, trigger or migration is created or changed.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative get-Space handler, membership/capability derivation, audit provenance, archive effect, mutation or reconciliation exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/Space/scope evidence is not authorization. No membership, existing-row, Project/Inventory/Space predicate, grant or cross-account database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Space/checklist table, authenticated download predicate, subscription, upload connector or synchronized visibility proof is defined.

items: Request, core row, local snapshot and updates are canonical Codable evidence over stable IDs, scope, normalized content, lifecycle/revision/timestamps, canonical checklist state, readiness/completeness, local version and as-of time; canonical decode/encode is byte-identical.

At-most-one cardinality, exact request/row binding and explicit completeness prevent an empty incomplete cache from becoming authoritative absence. Derived progress is final only when the enclosing evidence is complete.

A deterministic reference port may stream exact request-matching updates and bounded failures and prove cancellation; this is not physical durable storage, process/device persistence, current authorization or authenticated synchronization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Core details carry no AttachmentID, object locator, URL, image/PDF byte, marker, upload, cache, retention or deletion behavior; O-023 remains open.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Space detail SwiftUI view, navigation, checklist control, archive action, MCP schema/tool/resource/handler, transport or app/MCP parity wiring is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Space DTO, nullable projectId, randomized missing checklist ID, client timestamp, listener result, URL, export row or migration disposition is decoded or transformed.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no telemetry signal, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authorize, persist, synchronize or present a production Space; archive/restore/delete, assign/clear Items, attach media, create review evidence, apply/save templates, change accounting, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-023/O-026/O-037 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain outside this boundary. Physical offline verification, production profiling and all hosted-resource authority remain gated.

verification.expected: Project and Business Inventory rows preserve exact identity/scope, normalized name/notes, active/archived state, revision, finite exact timestamps, stable ordered nested checklist state and exact derived per-checklist/aggregate counts, including valid empty 0/0 and same item ID in different checklists.

Ready found, ready authoritative-absent, ready incomplete found/empty, partial found/empty and stale found/empty fixtures round-trip byte-identically with exact request/local version/as-of/readiness/completeness evidence; archived found never becomes absent and incomplete counts remain labeled non-authoritative.

Account/Space/request/scope/fingerprint mismatch, multiple-row or hidden-count evidence, incomplete-as-authoritative state, nonfinite row/as-of time, malformed/noncanonical content and duplicate checklist/order or within-checklist item/order evidence fail atomically through stable bounded diagnostics.

Unavailable is non-enumerating and yields no row/absence detail; retryable and required-update remain distinct; cached failure evidence must match the exact request and cannot grant authorization or upgrade incompleteness.

A deterministic reference port streams only exact Account/Space request updates, propagates bounded upstream failure, rejects rebound cached data and stops delivery on cancellation without emitting a false row or false authoritative absence.

notes: Implemented decision-independent Phase 1 query boundary, pending immutable CI on the exact integration checkpoint before verification. Candidate 1920389d28a71fff3b3233bef2971fe9525bc6e3 descends from exact green ready commit 8849344dc66d71d9dd9b9ba589a76deb007f3172 and changed only the two allowlisted paths. Primary every-line review found three test gaps: direct normalization refusal for notes/checklist names/item text, independent AccountID/SpaceID fingerprint binding, and request validation inside the reference port rather than only its consumer. After correction, an independent adversarial review found one P3 diagnostic-stability gap; a test-only correction pinned all 18 exact unique public codes. Primary and independent focused reruns passed 6 tests, independent and primary full reruns passed all 199 tests in 46 suites, target isolation and clean diffs passed, and no P0-P3 finding remains. Integrated as 72b24afa/503b3839/05509124. Timestamp provenance/order, percentage, archive effects, Item/assignment, media, review, template, legacy completion, accounting, provider/schema/RLS/Sync, app/MCP, migration and production claims remain excluded; O-023/O-026/O-037 remain open. SPACECORE-TEST-006 remains planned until exact-integration-checkpoint immutable CI succeeds.
